Draft/Notes:
Subject: On‑call schedule change — two‑week shifts starting Sept 15

Hi team,

Starting Sept 15 we’re moving on‑call from one‑week to two‑week shifts. This change aims to reduce handoffs, improve incident continuity, and give everyone more predictable recovery time. The updated schedule will be posted to the on‑call calendar by the end of the week — please review and flag any conflicts by [date]. For questions or urgent conflicts, contact your manager or the on‑call coordinator. Thanks for your flexibility.

— [Your name / Team]
